avis.titre: Fill the bottles up OR just use smaller bottles
avis.texte: I absolutely love Dermalogica—it's the only skincare brand I've used for over 20 years. That said, I've recently noticed a disappointing change: the bottles no longer seem to be filled the way they used to be. It's incredibly frustrating to spend so much money and feel like you're only getting half the product. A few weeks ago, I ordered the Collagen Banking Serum ($89) and received a bottle with virtually no product inside. Yes, I know Ulta allows returns and exchanges, but that doesn't make the experience any less inconvenient or disappointing. Dermalogica, please—either fill the bottles the way you used to, or switch to smaller packaging that reflects the actual amount of product inside. Loyal customers shouldn't feel like they're being shortchanged.
So much lighter than regular foundation and I love how it adjusts to my skin color from season to season.
It immediately clumped on my face and left little bits / residue. Also had no tint. It looked like my skin was flaking after i put it on.

Doesn't minimize pores rather leaves an oily finish. Doesn't go on easy. Also didn't find it has any tint. Nothing special about this product. Only pro is no white residue as some natural zinc products have.
I LOVE this sunscreen! It doesn't break me out, it's not greasy, and it looks great with or without makeup! It does feel pretty tacky at first but it goes away quickly.

Dermalogica's matte spf was my all time favorite sunscreen and I was pretty upset when they discounted it. since then i've tried a wide range of mineral and chemical sunscreens. I have sensitive combo skin and prefer something light weight and non greasy, and this spf is it! feels a bit tacky at first but once it dries down you're left with a beautiful skin like finish. It also works great under foundation, and sometimes i even mix the two together to make my own tinted sunscreen. Overall this is a great facial spf that I'd recommend for anyone with combo/normal and even oily skin!
Great product, blurs pores and is a good primer to put your make up on.

I wear sunscreen everyday (and you should too). I actually really like this consistency and the way that my skin feels when I have it on! I can actually wear it under makeup too and it doesn't pill at all. This was gifted by dermalogica.
I love this sunblock so much but it's hard to justify the cost for the size. I'd expect this to be closer to two ounces.
Yellow/orange tint, verrrrry noticeable. I typically love Dermalogica products, this one was a disappointment.
So orange, I would never be able to blend this to make it look OK. it was comical how fast it went from the white out of the bottle to a very deep orange.

I REALLY wanted to like this due to the price but it was absolutely terrible. It flaked on my skin so bad. The first time I used it I used it on it's own and blended it with my fingers and it left flakey streaks on my face. So the second time I used my skincare first and tried to blend this in with a beauty blender and got the same results. Both times I shook the tube well according to the label and got the same results. Very sad this didn't work for me!

avis.titre: Sunscreen that I'm finally happy with!
avis.texte: Finally, a sunscreen that I am happy with. I don't leave the house without it on my face.

This is one of the best sunscreens that I've used. It isn't oily, doesn't leave a white cast (there may be a slight white cast upon application, but it will disappear within 5-10 minutes), and provides good protection from the sun.
Its easy to apply, not greasy, good SPF coverage, like it's a mineral sunscreen.dermalogica is a brand I trust.
First thought, I did not like the smell at all. I also did not feel like it blurred, nor had a good tint, like the Skin Perfect primer which does in fact have a beautiful tint.
Smooth light feeling on the skin, doesn't cause breakouts and no white residue

Pros- does not clog pores and a little seems to go a long way compared to others Cons- too pricey, even though it seems like the bottle will last a while with the small amount used, it's kind of ridiculous to pay that much. It smells weird even after a few weeks and used to it, still not pleasant. Tint is yellow which is ok for my olive Asian skin but maybe not for those with fairer skin. It can come off when I scratch my face, I get yellow under my nails, even if it's been on for hours.

I have fair skin, and the tint in the product made me look like a ghost. There is also a strong odor, that I personally found unpleasant, and could smell for several hours after application. I tried out this product as a trial freebie. Glad I didnt spend money on it.

After putting it on for a few days (maybe 3). My skin next to my ears starting to breakout. Now anytime I put it on my skin turned hot and itchy like crazy. I love this brand and has other products from them with no issue. Not sure why my skin doesn't like this.

This sunscreen feels light and hydrating at the same time. I use it daily on my sensitive skin and haven't had any issues so far. The high level of sun protection is important to me as a good benefit.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again and again
avis.texte: Non greasy sun protection that works well alone and under makeup. Does blend in with your skin color and slightly blurs skin brown spots and blemishes.

avis.texte: Hey Ulta, Dimethicone is a silicone. This product should not come up with your silicone free search filter.
This is so so for me. Not wonderful but there's nothing wrong - other than the smell - with it.

I dont really like SPF's they break my skin out but i do love this one. avis.titre: Sheer, but wouldn't call this tinted

Out of all the brands I've tried through working at Ulta, Dermalogica has the BEST SPF! This one is mineral and blends right into you're skin with no white cast, which is hard to find. Esthetician approved :)

avis.titre: Mineral Sunscreen w/o White Cast and Great for Acne!

I really haven't had a chance to use it yet but if its anything like all the other products, it'll be great!

This is a great everyday sunscreen for the face. It absorbs quickly and feels light on the skin. It left no whitening effect on my tan skin tone. I also have an oily complexion and had no issues. My face glowed all day!

It does dry down slightly, but I would have liked it to have a little less grip. It does do its job, but it's pricier than it needs to be. In my opinion, there are other options. I will finish this product, but it's not close to being one of my favorite SPFs or favorite product from Dermalogica.

i like this porescreen gifted by Dermalogica. i like how it is spf 40 also. i like how it doesn't leave a white cast and easy to apply. i'm excited to use this during the summer because it is not sticky at all
Great face protection before boat ride. No face sunburn at all!

The perfect sunscreen under makeup! This sunscreen feels like a primer that smooths my pores and looks great under makeup. I love wearing this sunscreen on its own as well. A summer staple! *I received a sample of this product complimentary from Dermalogica, but all opinions are my own.

** gifted by Dermalogica ** This has become my favorite sunscreen for under my makeup! It's smoothing, but not drying, for my dry skin. I struggle with most sunscreens causing breakouts and making my pores look larger, but this has been great! Would recommend!

i love this sunscreen. it doesn't give me a white cast like the other sunscreens or turn my skin purple. It does have a little tint so it's perfect for summer. it's also not super thick or super thin so you can even mix it with your lotion. this product was gifted by dermalogica-ulta

This is a great lightweight facial sunscreen! I love that it's SPF 40 so I feel like I'm getting good protection. The product blends nicely into the skin and has a little bit of a blurring effect which is nice! gifted by dermalogica

Gifted by dermalogica

avis.titre: Sensitive skin safe & sweat proof sunscreen

This is such a great product! I always love trying out new spf products and this one exceeeded my expectations! Such a great product for everyone and just worked great for both me and wife! Gifted by detmlogica

Dermalogica always coming with the best products!! This sunscreen is so good, my skin is absolutely loving it, you definitely see a difference in your pores after a few uses, as well as this product is noncomedogenic. Gifted by Dermalogica

Gifted by dermologica! I'm obsessed with this texture! It's extremely light weight and has a little big of a sheer coverage since it's tinted! It's super easy to apply and looks great on its own or under makeup!

gifted by Dermalogica. this sunscreen has a bit of a white cast on my medium tan poc skin. it's runny out of the bottle but feels thicker upon application. after a while though it does settle into your skin. i will say the tint is almost nonexistent though.

This was gifted by Dermalogica - Ulta in exchange for an honest review. I am loving this sunscreen so far! It feels really nice going on and sinks into the skin really easily. It layered on top of my other skin care well and sat well under makeup. A new favorite for sure.
hydrates well, I find it covers my face evenly and kind of gives off a shimmery/tanned look.

This product has a smooth consistency and doesn't give me a white residue after setting! I feel like it helps even more with my makeup application and now I don't need a primer. I also love how I can reapply and it doesn't feel greasy, happy to get this gifted by Dermalogica- Utla

Love this sunscreen. It does not add to my oil problem. It controls the oil. I live in a humid climate and the sunscreen protects my face from the sun and helps to control oi.

Really enjoying how lightweight the SPF is. It absorbs into my skin so nicely, leaves a nice glow making my skin look healthy & ZERO WHITE CAST! Makeup applies over it nicely also! I was sent this complimentary from Dermalogica.

Really enjoyed this product. It match my skin color very well and loved that I applied it easily with my hands. This product didn't make me break out and it also made my skin hydrated. I do recommend this product. Gifted by Dermalogica.

I love this sunscreen! It gives an amazing glow to the skin something I've never seen in any other sunscreen I've used. You do have to blend it in a lot when using other products but to me that's not an issue. This was gifted to me from Dermalogica.

I very rarely find a sunscreen I can wear on my face without breaking me out. I was gifted by Dermalogica this one to try and I've already ordered more. I love this product so much! I think that the amount of product is amazinf and it feels like a good product that spread around well but also balences out my face well! I layered makeup on top as well and it was good gifted by dermalogica

I definitely would like to try out a full size version of this product. I think it would be a perfect primer for the summer months or when on vacation. I do not use less than 40 spf on my face so I was a fan seeing that. Overall I do like it. If you are looking for a tinted sunscreen this is not tinted, but it gives you a great blurring and luminous glow after applying! It is very even & that is big when it comes to sunscreen with zinc in it!

This sunscreen gifted by Dermologica - Ulta is so amazing! I love the finish that it leaves on my skin… it is not like your stereotypical facial sunscreen. It's more like a skincare product with SPF included in it. I highly recommend!

This product was gifted by Dermalogica in turn for me to do an honest review in return, so here it is! This product blends nicely and has a very small tint to it that I like because it's not too noticeable. It does the job and I do like this sunscreen, but I think there are better ones out there.

Gifted by Dermalogica-Ulta With summer right around the corner I'm always looking for the best sun care products for my skin. This sun care product is phenomenal! It smells amazing, easy to apply, and a little goes along way. I highly recommend this product!

Love it! It gives a beautiful blurred effect that evens out my skin. The product is on the thicker side but it's easy to apply and doesn't have an awful smell like most sunscreens I've used. Great sunscreen, super easy to apply, good protection, I've melasma and I can see it has well protected my skin. It didn't leave any white trace, and you can apply it before make up. I recommend it. Product was gifted to me by the brand for testing purposes.

I love the fact that this product smells good and actually works. I do wish it was 50 spf but no complaints on the product itself. A little goes a long way with this product so it's worth the money:pray::skin-tone-3:

This is a really nice sunscreen. It blends effortlessly into my skin and doesnt pill or leave any white cast. I like that it helps blur my pores and acts as a bit of a primer. I really like it for summer. Gifted by Dermalogica

I have tried this product and I honestly really like. I like wearing sunblock to prevent wrinkles and protect my skin but i also still want to get tan. This sunblock protects my skin from getting burnt and makes my face feel so good.gifted by dermalogica

This product was gifted by Dermalogica. I have always been a fan of Dermalogica products. I have using before their sunscreen and I love it. I love this product because you definitely put it into your pores and helps you a lot not to noticed them

Loveee dermalogica products and this is amazing as usual! Love that it is spf and it goes on so smoothly! Feels great on my skin and super lightweight! I highly recommend trying it out! It is a really quality product! gifted by dermalogica - ulta
